source.title: Asian Championship 2010 on October 9-10, 2010 in Bangkok, Thailand
source.content: The [Asian Championship 2010](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=AsianChampionship2010) will take place on October 9-10, 2010 in Bangkok, Thailand. Check out the [Asian Championship 2010 website](http://www.thailandcube.com/ac2010) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2010 年亚洲锦标赛将于 10 月 9–10 日在泰国曼谷举行
